AUG 0 1 2025 HON. RANDY T. GENIL, ET AL. Sangguniang Barangay Member Barangay Poblacion l, Laurel, Batangas Dear SB Member Genil, et al: This in reference to your earlier letter seeking clarification on the appointment process for Barangay Treasurer. Per your letter, your Punong Barangay has appointed Ms. Arlyn Magpantay as Barangay Treasurer of Barangay Poblacion I. You represented that as a member of the Sangguniang Barangay of Poblacion you did not concur to the appointment of Ms. Magpantay as Barangay Treasurer nor did they issue a resolution of non-concurrence thereto. When the matter was brought to the DILG Field Office, you were advised that Ms. Magpantay will hold office in a temporary capacity pending concurrence from the Sangguniang Barangay. Hence, the herein request for clarification. May it be respectfully informed that the issue herein has already been discussed and settled in DILG Legal Opinion No. 17, S. 20091, pertinent portion of which reads: "Article II, Sections 4 and 5 of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2002- 150 provide that: Section 4 Pending Compliance with the condition of concurrence, the appointee, in the exigency of public, shall be allowed to discharge and perform the powers, duties and responsibilities pertaining to the office and they shall be considered to be holding a temporary appointment. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA 6713, otherwise known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Official and Employees" the Sangguniang Barangay shall act on the appointment within fifteen (15) working days from receipt of the appointment as submitted by the punong barangay In the case of Alquizola V. Oc012, the Supreme Court ruled that "the power to appoint is to be exercised conjointly by the Punong Barangay and a majority of all the members ot the sangguniang barangay." Such being the case. the correlative duty of the members of the Sanqqunianq ' March 25. 2009 G n. No, 123413, August 27. 1999 "Matino. Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No Æ 8876-34-54

Barangay being referred to would now be the required concurrence. and pending concurrence. beinq the final phase of appointment. shall make the appointment temporary.' Applying the above-cited provisions of Section 394 of the LGC, the DILG Memorandum and the Supreme Court ruling in the matter at hand, the appointment of the barangay treasurer may only be recognized as valid in accordance with law upon the concurrence by the majority members of the Sangguniang Barangay. Without the conjoint action of appointment and concurrence, neither an appointment nor a replacement can be effectual.3 Nonetheless, the appointed Treasurer may assume her duties in an acting capacity pending concurrence by the majority members of the Sangguniang Barangay. However, once the Sangguniang Barangay expresses officially its non-concurrence to the appointment, the barangay treasurer shall not anymore be allowed to perform her duties.4 May it be emphasized, however, that while the power to concur is given to the Sangguniang Barangay, said body is not vested with so much plenary discretionary powers. The power to concur is intended for the sanggunian to determine whether or not the appointee of the Punong Barangay possesses all the qualifications prescribed for Barangay Treasurer under the LGC and such other qualifications provided by existing laws. If the appointee, therefore, possesses all qualifications provided by law, then the Sangguniang Barangay has no other far-reaching powers except to issue the concurrence.5 Consequently, the appointee shall be allowed to discharge and perform the powers and duties pertaining to the office and shall be considered to be holding a temporary appointment in the exigency of public service, pending compliance with the condition of concurrence. We hope to have guided you on the matter. This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P.
